g.text: Figure 2: Activity Diagram - Document Upload to Client Notification (End-to-End Workflow)
Open case, select PDF or DOCX
Valid file type and consent given?
Review extracted fields and draft summary
Create deadline records from extracted dates
Run NLP field extraction: dates, plaintiff,
defendant, attorneys, judge, case number, court
Attach confidence score, source text span
and page number to each field (explainability)
no - wrong matter or no case content
deadlines; status = PROCESSED; write audit entry
Set status = REJECTED with reason, highlight
conflicting spans, add to admin rejection
